reading.action: Fighting retreat: back rapidly to the entrance neck to collapse the flank into one lane, channel a powerful Ember Wave down that direction as they close, then turn and run out past the threshold. Eyes-closed.
reading.result: FUNNEL-WAVE LANDS CLEAN on real bodies (iris-prep ruling). Backing into the neck collapsed the flank into single-file pursuit (his own geometry-solve, t58 funnel logic); the Ember Wave down the one lane the real bodies must come through bypassed the tier-3 heat-jam (decoys are woven light, don't chase a physical lane) -> burned real predators, gate 1.0 neutral (area, not a pinned weak-point). 1d20=14 clean -> margin 39.5 -> 60 to the LEAD (82 HP, survives 22 left), trailing pursuer spill x0.5 -> 30. Neither dropped (right feel for area + neutral + under-charged). He can't confirm a kill blind — feels them recoil, not die. XP-neutral / no progression.
